g.text: Note: 29,971 legislator stance records (prompt stance-extraction-0.3-dev) placed on codebook v1.0, House Science and Senate Commerce hearings held 1999-2025. A record is one member

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: position: cited sentences, an issue, and support or concern. Years are hearing held years; administrations are calendar-year blocks (Bush 2001-2008, Obama 2009-2016, Trump 2017-2020, Biden

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: 2021-2024, Trump 2025). For each topic the break year is the year that maximizes the change in support share between all records before it and all records from it on, with at least 50 records on

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: each side. The right margin gives that year and the change in net stance; a p-value is printed only when a Welch test does not reject equal support shares at 0.01.
